messages:
tay: Heads up — embeddings started returning bursts of 5xxs at 22:40 UTC. Quick triage points to migration sidecar hang. Need hotfix to restart worker & flip migration flag. Requesting expedited SRE+Product approvals for a 23:00-23:30 UTC window. deploybot intake?

deploybot: Intake acknowledged. Hotfix template: image=redwood/embeds:2026.03-hotfix-mig3, canary=10% for 4m. Requirements: approvals from @sam (SRE) and @pm_julie (Product), runbook + rollback one-liner. Use `/deploy kick 6512349876 --window 23:00-23:30 --manual-gate`.

sam: Oncall SRE. Need rollback cmd and abort thresholds. Will run quick staging smoke.

tay: Runbook (short): 1) Kick canary 10% for 4m. 2) Monitor errors via /dash?svc=embeds&window=4m; abort if errors >0.9% or p95 +200ms. 3) Rollback: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/embeds embeds=redwood/embeds:2026.03-stable && kubectl rollout status deploy/embeds`. 4) Post release note to #release-notes.

ivy: Product here — no schema changes, release note draft: "Hotfix: restart embeddings worker and toggle migration flag to remediate intermittent 5xxs. No API changes."

sam: Staging smoke OK at 22:52 UTC. Approve after canary looks healthy.

deploybot: Manual gate created. Approvals required: `/deploy approve 6512349876 --by @sam` and `/deploy approve 6512349876 --by @pm_julie`.

tay: Kicking canary at 23:01 UTC (cb-6512349876). Initial canary: errors=0.12%, p95 +30ms.

sam: Canary green from SRE, `/deploy approve 6512349876 --by @sam`

pm_julie: Approving from Product, `/deploy approve 6512349876 --by @pm_julie`

deploybot: Approvals recorded. Promoting to 100% at 23:06 UTC. Rollout complete 23:08 UTC. Post-rollout metrics: errors ~0.1%, p95 within baseline. No rollback executed.

tay: Monitoring bridge open +20m. Will post final release note and close after monitor. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
